reasoning: The caps are named constants with a stated rationale (UpdateChecker.swift:53-57). They reuse the existing sendBounded instead of creating a second bounded reader, and the checksums redirect policy reuses isAllowedDownloadURL (UpdateChecker.swift:388) rather than copying the host list. But the fix makes a name lie. At HTTPClient.swift:221 the private class `SameOriginRedirectDelegate` now follows redirects to any HTTPS host the `allow` closure accepts (line 252, `allow?(url) ?? sameOrigin(url)`). For the checksums call that means a cross-origin redirect to the GitHub CDN. The type is no longer a same-origin delegate, and a future reader will assume the same-origin guarantee the name promises. Rubric item 6 (name that lies after the fix).
required_changes: Rename SameOriginRedirectDelegate (HTTPClient.swift:221 and its use at :153) to a name that describes the actual policy, e.g. `HTTPSRedirectPolicyDelegate` / `BoundedRedirectDelegate`, and add a one-line doc: same-origin by default, `allow` predicate when given, always HTTPS without userinfo.
